تعتلون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَلُونَ (taʕtalūna) /taʕ.ta.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# تُعْتَلَوْنَ (tuʕtalawna) /tuʕ.ta.law.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
